replies.author: ViceTechnicolour
replies.body:
Your mapping skills are getting better, but I suggest you put a beacon behind where the flag is, because it's an enclosed map and it'd help to find the objective easier for new players :)

The map also should have a less random floor... it doesn't look very nice :(
EDIT: You have the wrong XML, it says "Abandoned Castle CTF" and has the wrong colors
